shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi && cat .lore/dod.md'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.logging.test.ts && cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json'

/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('ajv/package.json').version\" && ls node_modules/ajv && rg -n 'ajv|registry.logging|spec-links' package-lock.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs jest.config.js && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && ls scripts/spec-links"

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat jest.config.js && cat tsconfig.json && cat .github/workflows/ci.yml | head -100 && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -35 && cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -100 && git log -3 --oneline'

/bin/zsh -lc "git show 483eb5b:package-lock.json | sed -n '4870,4900p' && cat .npmrc 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n 'validated by.*validated by' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && ls node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts && cat AGENTS.md | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import {createRequire} from 'node:module';\\nimport type {ValidateFunction} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\", \"import {Ajv, type ValidateFunction} from 'ajv';\")
s=s.replace(\"\\nconst Ajv = createRequire(import.meta.url)('ajv') as typeof import('ajv/dist/ajv.js').Ajv;\\n\",'\\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.logging.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"    expect(logged).toMatch(/location.*string/);\\n    expect(logged).not.toContain('123456789');\", \"    expect({logged, leaked: logged.includes('123456789')}).toEqual({\\n      logged: expect.stringMatching(/location.*string/),\\n      leaked: false,\\n    });\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('registry.logging.test.ts#L6)) ([validated by:', 'registry.logging.test.ts#L6), [validated by:')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Add unit tests in', '- [x] Fix CI validation error paths, logging assertions and spec links.\\n- [ ] Add unit tests in')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
 timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.paths.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.logging.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.paths.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.logging.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.paths.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix validation logging and Ajv imports" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb'
